rounds.text: RBZ Jewellers is currently trading at a significant valuation discount, with a P/E of 9.89x [E1] compared to a sector benchmark of 28.09x [E6], and an EV/EBITDA of 7.52x against a sector benchmark of 15.25x [E11]. This undervaluation persists despite the company delivering robust compounded profit growth of 42% over the last five years [E17] and 54% over the trailing twelve months [E19]. The business demonstrates superior capital efficiency, with an ROE of 20.1% [E13] and ROCE of 21.8% [E12], both of which significantly outperform their respective sector benchmarks [E9, E10]. Management is actively driving future growth through a clear retail expansion strategy in Gujarat, with new showrooms in Surat and Rajkot targeted to commence operations by Q2 FY27 [E76, E86]. Furthermore, the company is scaling its product portfolio, having launched 730 new designs in a single quarter [E81]. Conceded: the company faces negative cash flow [E28, E29], a lack of dividend payouts [E4, E55], and a notable decline in institutional holdings [E36, E37, E38].
